# P32.12 — Bounded document adapters for the pilot dossiers

**Requirement ids:** SIG-ACQ-003 (§55.6) ·
**ADR:** ADR-131 ·
**Base:** `devin/p32-11-gap-driven-source-discovery` (stacked on PR #167 — merge this after #167) ·
**Run:** `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/172_P32.12__dossier-document-adapters.md live_verification=false` ·
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/172_P32.12__dossier-document-adapters.md` (manifest row 172)

## What this does

One registered connector — **`dossier_documents`**
(`connectors/src/connectors/dossier_documents.py`) — serves all three gated
pilot dossier source families (`dossier_okc`, `dossier_tulsa`,
`dossier_san_diego`) through the existing eight-stage pipeline. Per-source
behaviour is **data, not code**: the shared vocabulary
(`dossier-documents/1`) and the frozen field crosswalk
(`dossier-field-crosswalk/1`) under
`connectors/src/connectors/data/`. All three registry rows stay
`ingestion_permitted=false` with UNDETERMINED rights — fixture success is an
engineering check, never a rights decision, a gate flip, or publication
approval. `D-R10-SOURCES-1` stays OPEN (annotated): the exact-target review,
HG-03 flip and bounded live pilot remain with P32.18–P32.21 + the operator.

### Adapter shape (bounded by construction)

- **≤2 document protocols** — `html_text` (layer-2 selector extraction) and
  `pdf_text` (layer-3 digital-native PDF text); no OCR, no third parser.
- **Two format handlers** — `clause_fields` (reviewed per-field extraction
  over a document) and `index_listing` (link fan-out emitting
  `document`/`title`/`posted_date` rows — a listing proves the index carried
  the link, not the document's contents).
- **Hard resource bounds** — 1 MiB document bytes, 40 PDF pages, 64
  configured fields, 512 KiB extracted text, 128 index links. Any violation
  is an explicit `ContentDrift` failure; malformed/encrypted/unsupported
  documents likewise — **no partial affirmative claims** are emitted for
  failed documents.
- **Reviewed literals must exist in the captured bytes.** Every configured
  `answered` field's literal is located in the stored capture and carries a
  typed locator (byte ranges for HTML/index evidence, page locators for
  PDF). A configured literal absent from the bytes is content drift — an
  explicit failure, never a guessed value.

### The frozen crosswalk (`dossier-field-crosswalk/1`)

Every configured field resolves to a row naming: the **existing** ontology
predicate (validated at load via the new public
`ontology.generate.load_vocab()` — no duplicated predicate list), qualifier
semantics (`count_scope`/`count_scope_detail`/`evidence_origin`),
organisation role (`db.organization_roles` — a publisher can never mint an
operational role), valid-time class (`publication|effective|coverage|as_of|
none` — posting dates, effective dates, coverage windows and `as_of` dates
stay distinct; `none` bars `valid_*` promotion), the S2 dossier rubric
field (q1…q12) and an applicability rationale. A configured field with no
row — or a `required` field whose row is `needs_amendment` — fails
`check_crosswalk()`; `sig-connectors validate` now runs the check.

- **`execution_state` is the recorded scoped amendment** (`needs_amendment`):
  the proposal for `instrument_execution_state` over a closed
  reviewer-assessed enum {verified_executed, partially_signed,
  unsigned_template, not_visually_verified} is documented on the row; the
  field emits only field-state evidence until a future schema ticket
  consumes it — signature presence never infers execution.

### Genre is a mechanical epistemic guard

- `template_execution_guard`: a `template` document may never assert
  executed-instrument predicates (parties, signatures, values, term dates,
  lifecycle) — a blank MOU proves structure only.
- `subscription_hardware_guard`: a `subscription` document may never assert
  local-hardware predicates — hosted-database access is never sensor
  inventory.
- ADR-122 non-probative genres (`template`, `recommendation`,
  `subscription`, `vendor_default_page`) stamp every emitted claim
  `claim_directness = "D6"` — made mechanical, not conventional.
- Field states are closed: `answered` → typed value claim;
  `present_but_empty`/`absent` → `disclosure_field_state` claims (mandated-
  but-unanswered is recorded evidence, never silently skipped); `redacted`
  → `somevalue`, never a fabricated literal.
- The Part VIII forbidden-token/person-naming guard is the shared
  `okc_documents` implementation — consumed, not forked. Name-only partner
  claims mint `sig.org.name_scoped` entity-ref twins (role from the
  crosswalk, asserting source + jurisdiction scope, `candidate=True` —
  never merged identities, SIG-TRUST-004).

## Acceptance-criteria evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Common eight-stage adapter for all three families; ≤2 protocols; data-driven | `DossierDocumentsConnector` registered once; `document_protocols()` asserts ≤2; `[adapters.*]` TOML config — `test_connector_registered_and_routed`, `test_protocol_cap_is_two_or_fewer`, `test_adapter_config_is_data` |
| New rows blocked; loader gate refuses | `test_new_source_rows_stay_blocked`, `test_loader_gate_refuses_blocked_sources`, registry `ingestion_permitted=false` + UNDETERMINED rights, no review metadata |
| Crosswalk frozen + validated; unmapped/needs_amendment fails closed | `check_crosswalk()` wired into `sig-connectors validate`; `test_crosswalk_all_configured_fields_resolve`, `test_unmapped_field_fails_closed`, `test_required_needs_amendment_field_fails_review` |
| Reviewed literals located in bytes; drift explicit | `test_reviewed_literal_absent_from_bytes_is_drift`, `_target` deep-copy isolation |
| Genre guards + D6 | `test_template_never_asserts_executed_instrument`, `test_subscription_never_asserts_hardware`, `test_non_probative_genre_stamps_d6` |
| Field states without synthetic certainty | `test_absent_field_emits_disclosure_state`, `test_present_but_empty_emits_state`, `test_redacted_emits_somevalue_not_literal`, `test_execution_state_emits_field_state_only` |
| Typed locators + golden output | `test_golden_locators`, `test_byte_ranges_for_html`, `test_page_locators_for_pdf` |
| Bounded failures explicit | `test_malformed_document_fails_explicitly`, `test_oversized_document_refused`, `test_encrypted_pdf_fails_explicitly`, `test_unsupported_format_fails_closed`, `test_excessive_pages/fields/links` |
| Replay/shadow determinism; no socket | `test_same_fixture_replays_deterministically`, `test_shadow_replay_zero_differences`, `test_replay_opens_no_network` |
| Partner refs scoped, never merged | `test_vendor_role_mints_scoped_entity_ref_twin` (sig.org.name_scoped, jurisdiction-scoped, candidate=True) |
| Part VIII | `test_forbidden_tokens_fail`, `test_person_naming_gate` — shared `okc_documents` guard |

## Not done (explicitly out of scope)

- No live fetch, no `ingestion_permitted` flip, no `rights_decision` minted —
  all remain under `D-R10-SOURCES-1` (OPEN, annotated) and HG-03.
- OCR/image-only documents: out of the ≤2-protocol contract; unreadable
  captures fail explicitly rather than gap-silently.
- The `instrument_execution_state` predicate: recorded as a scoped amendment
  on the crosswalk row for the next schema/vocab ticket — the field emits
  field-state evidence only.
- Real published-URL verification: fixtures are representative stand-ins
  (see `tests/connectors/fixtures/dossier/SOURCES.md`); bounded pilot
  acquisition is owed by P32.18–P32.21.
